test_title: PYST 34: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

In some institutions, additional teaching / assistants will hired to / teach high school students.
solution:
The erroneous part is: **assistants will hired to**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in the **future tense**, indicating an action that will take place in the future.
 
• The correct form of the future tense is 'will be hired' or 'will have been hired'.
 
• However, the given sentence uses the incorrect form 'will hired'. 
 
• Therefore, option 3) assistants will hired to contains the error.

The corrected form of the sentence is: *In some institutions, additional teaching assistants **will be hired** to teach high school students.*
